responsibility: Implements the main procedural backend logic for the RL78 target behind the declarations in rl78.h/rl78-protos.h and the md patterns in rl78*.md. It owns RL78 target hooks and helper routines for function frame and machine-function state setup, prologue/epilogue and interrupt-related behavior, section and symbol handling, asm output details, reload/addressing preferences, libcall emission, operand/address classification, and late RTL manipulation such as the RL78 devirtualization/reorg pass that rewrites the virtual instruction layer from rl78-virt.md into real RL78 instructions and performs target-specific cleanups and peephole-style optimizations.
same_name_distinction: Contains the executable C target-backend implementation for RL78: it defines target hooks, helper routines, asm output support, libcall emission, frame/prologue logic, and the RL78-specific RTL passes such as devirtualization/reorg that work with patterns from rl78.md. Unlike rl78.h it is not the macro/configuration interface, unlike rl78.md it does not declaratively encode insn patterns, and unlike rl78.opt it does not define command-line target options.
